# Rewati Raman Singh

> chasing greatness

Personal engineering portfolio of Rewati Raman Singh. AI systems, edge intelligence, real-time vision, and agent memory architectures.

## Core Expertise & Projects
- Preschool AI Surveillance: End-to-end AI surveillance system turning ordinary camera feeds into real-time understanding of crowded preschool environments. Features visual detection, tracking, identity, activity understanding, and asynchronous inference.
- Zero Egress Indic Translation: Offline enterprise translation system for Indic languages where sensitive data never leaves the edge device.
- Agent Memory Architectures: Persistent context and memory systems for AI healthcare agents with strict zero-leak PII redaction and compliance.
